evals.prompt: Use the sdk-patterns skill. In my Node app I want to pull the pricing plans from one URL as structured data with the Firecrawl SDK, and also let a research agent find the top vendors across several sites. Show the code.
evals.expected_output: Should install firecrawl, scrape with a json format (prompt and schema) and read doc.json, and use firecrawl.agent with maxCredits for the research
expectations: The answer installs the Node SDK with npm install firecrawl
The answer calls scrape with a json format that holds a prompt and a schema
The answer reads the extracted data from the json property of the result
The answer uses the agent method for the research over several sites
The answer sets maxCredits on the agent call
